packageRules.description: The JSON Schema validator is a BEHAVIOR-BEARING dependency: a patch bump can change a validation verdict, which changes whether a worker's `complete` is refused. That is a behavior change arriving through a dependency PR nobody reads as a behavior change (docs/tdd/payloads-thresholds.md §4.1). Hold it for a week and label it so the bump is reviewed against internal/schema/testdata/corpus — TestCorpus is the gate — rather than auto-merged.
